name: pdk-d6tflow-pipeline
instr:
Our sales vendor now re-sends daily files when they correct them. Each night ops copies the vendor's drop over the landing folder. A week of drops is in /data/vendor/ (one folder per night), and /data/sales_flow.py is our flow. The landing files are external tasks, each day gets cleaned, and a last step totals the days.

The corrections never reach the totals because d6tflow.run sees the outputs exist and runs nothing. A run should bring the outputs up to date. A step runs again when a file it reads (the outputs of the tasks it requires, external ones included) has different content from when that step last ran, so after a run that succeeds the outputs match a run from scratch. A step whose input files have the same content as last time must not run, even if they were rewritten. Before the run, complete() and preview should show a step whose inputs changed, and every step that depends on it, as not complete.

A step only counts as up to date after a run of it finished without an error. Outputs that already exist the first time a run sees them count as up to date, and later changes are picked up as above. Workflow.run should behave the same, and reset and forced runs keep working as they do now.

We have several flows like this, so please fix it in d6tflow itself (/app), not in the flow. The existing tests in /app/tests have to keep passing. There's no network.
